conclusion: After actual adapted-copy controls were added, this prototype still found no high-similarity continuous excerpt in these two local recordings.
limitations: Only the two pinned local recordings are searched, not all model training data.
Positive controls estimate detector sensitivity to these transformations; no independent false-positive/false-negative study is available.
Only whole sample and five two-second windows are queried; shorter reuse and unqueried windows are not ruled out.
Unit direction representation ignores root travel, bone lengths, fingers, palm orientation and twist not visible in joint positions.
No dance-style, originality, physical-quality or licensing certification is inferred from this metric.
SOMA raw data is compared directly before retarget or feasibility solving.
Calibration was supplemented after the first raw result was already observed, and is not an independent blind originality evaluation.
Only two actual accepted adapted candidates and four windows each supplement the synthetic controls; arbitrary source-adaptation transformations are not exhaustively covered.
